notes: GoldSrc/HLDS, same command family as cs16 (verified live). rcon over UDP via the sidecar; maps queried live. MODDED VARIANT: this build runs Metamod + AMX Mod X, so the amx_* commands below exist IN ADDITION to the stock GoldSrc rcon verbs. They are issued over the same goldsrc rcon transport and AMXX replies on the console, so unlike the stock verbs most of them do return output. MAP VOTING is mapchooser.amxx: it opens a vote near map end drawn from mapcycle.txt, and amx_votemap forces one immediately. IMPORTANT: amx_map changes level directly and bypasses the vote entirely. The 20 custom skill maps are conc (scout/medic concussion) and rocket-jump (soldier) tracks; 2fort is the stock boot map. Clients need FASTDL_URL set or they will not finish downloading the custom content — HLDS throttles its own transfer to 8 kB/s.

commands.name: change_map
commands.description: Switch to a different map immediately (e.g. ctf_2fort, ctf_well).

commands.name: restart_round
commands.description: Restart the map after a delay in seconds.

commands.name: kick_player
commands.description: Kick a player by name or #userid (see the players query).

commands.name: ban_player
commands.description: Ban a player by userid for N minutes (0 = permanent).

minutes.description: Ban length in minutes; 0 is permanent

userid.description: Numeric userid from the players query

commands.name: say
commands.description: Broadcast a message to everyone on the server.

commands.name: set_join_password
commands.description: Set or clear the join password (empty clears it). Distinct from rcon.

commands.name: amx_map
commands.description: Change level immediately via AMXX. Bypasses the vote — use force_vote to let players decide instead.

commands.name: force_vote
commands.description: Open a next-map vote immediately, between the maps you name (1-4). Unlike mapchooser's automatic end-of-map vote, this does NOT read mapcycle.txt — amx_votemap takes its choices as arguments and prints usage if given none.

maps.description: One to four map names, space-separated, e.g. "concmap_r concmap_tg".

commands.name: cancel_vote
commands.description: Cancel a vote that is currently running.

commands.name: show_nextmap
commands.description: Report the map queued next in the cycle.

commands.name: time_left
commands.description: Report time remaining on the current map.

commands.name: extend_map
commands.description: Add minutes to the current map's time limit.

commands.name: amx_say
commands.description: Broadcast a message through AMXX (shown to all players).

commands.name: amx_kick_player
commands.description: Kick a player via AMXX. Matches on a partial name, unlike the stock kick.

commands.name: list_plugins
commands.description: List loaded AMXX plugins and whether each is running — the check for 'is mapchooser actually live'.

commands.name: list_modules
commands.description: List loaded AMXX modules (confirms the TFC module loaded).

commands.name: meta_list
commands.description: List Metamod plugins — confirms AMXX itself was chain-loaded by Metamod.

queries.name: players
queries.description: Connected players: userid, name and steamid, plus the current map. Use the userid with kick_player / ban_player.

cvars.name: mp_timelimit
cvars.description: Minutes per map before it changes.

cvars.name: mp_fraglimit
cvars.description: Frags to end the map (0 = none).
